seoTitle: Fix Instagram Likes Disappearing or Not Registering
metaDescription: Fix the Instagram bug where posts appear unliked right after you like them, by checking your connection and updating the app.
intro: If Instagram posts show as unliked right after you tap the like button, without you doing anything, it's usually a connection or app version issue rather than an account problem. This guide covers the two main fixes to try.

steps.heading: Check your internet connection
steps.body: Make sure you're connected to a strong, reliable network — a weak connection can prevent Instagram from registering actions like liking or unliking posts properly.

steps.heading: Update the Instagram app
steps.body: Open the Google Play Store or App Store, search for Instagram, and tap Update if available instead of Open, since an outdated app is a common cause of this bug.

steps.heading: Confirm the fix
steps.body: After updating or refreshing your connection, try liking a post again to check whether the issue is resolved.

faq.question: Why do my likes disappear right after I tap them?
faq.answer: This is usually caused by a poor internet connection or an outdated version of the Instagram app not registering the action correctly.

faq.question: Will updating Instagram fix the unlike bug?
faq.answer: In most cases, yes — updating to the latest version resolves bugs related to likes not registering properly.

faq.question: Is this a problem with my account or the app?
faq.answer: It's typically an app or connectivity issue rather than something wrong with your specific account.

faq.question: What should I try first if likes aren't registering?
faq.answer: Start by checking your internet connection, then update the app if the issue continues.
